purpose: Test whether a label-blind wall-surface specialist can preserve the subtle real defect_12 patch that the global adversarial verifier rejected.
evidence: Candidate detector fields: category, description, room, bbox, timestamp.
specialist_reasoning: Inspect wall-surface evidence specifically for localized differences in texture, finish, sanding, filled holes, patch boundaries, contour, sheen, or paint consistency.
A real repair may be subtle and need not show dramatic damage.
Explicitly compare against lighting gradients, shadows, normal wall texture, clean paint variation, trim, and floor/baseboard reflections.
Do not require the exact speculative cause in the detector wording to be true.
Preserve a visibly supported wall-surface condition while removing unsupported causal wording.
Reject when normal lighting or normal texture is the stronger explanation.
interpretation: This is a diagnostic-only specialist test and does not change official recall.
If the specialist preserves defect_12, consider routing subtle wall-surface candidates to this specialist while keeping the adversarial verifier for other categories.
If it rejects defect_12 again, specialist prompting alone is not sufficiently stable.
